1.

Glory, glory, eternal glory Be to Him who bore the cross; He who offered Himself in death And was a sweet savour to God; Sing His glory, Sing His glory, The Lord’s, who has saved us!

2.

The Lord’s love is infinite, Inexpressible, without measure; That its height and depth should be estimated Men have not been given the ability. Praise the Lord, Praise the Lord, Who in death went for us.

3.

While we here recount the wonder Of His death on the cross’s tree, We sing our song of praise already And worship now the Lamb of God. Hail Thee, Jesus! Hail Thee, Jesus! Glory be to Thy name now!
